verdict.rationale: Groq's docs explicitly instruct developers to reuse OpenAI SDKs by only changing api_key and base_url to https://api.groq.com/openai/v1, and state broad OpenAI client-library compatibility (chat completions, streaming, tool use, structured outputs, Responses API compatibility). Community evidence corroborates real-world usage of Groq as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation specifically of the base-URL swap working with zero other code changes (evidence is vendor-documented only).
